name: Barcarola
bio: Archetype: Inspiration, Star Impromptu, Buff Build-Up. ⌽ [Impromptu Incantation] becomes Star Afflatus, and [Inspiration] is more likely to be distributed to Attack skills. ⌽ Gains [Eureka] at turn start or whenever an ally casts an Attack skill. ⌽ Skills consume [Eureka] to strengthen [Impromptu Incantation] and increase its hit count. ⌽ Ult gives [Quartet] to self and one ally, and extends [Quartet]'s duration on other allies. It also restores 3 [Eureka] to allies with [Quartet] and refunds a Moxie. ⌽ Units with [Quartet] gain an ATK buff; buff improves for each unit in [Quartet]. When a [Quartet] unit casts an Attack skill, gains one [Inspiration] for the round and all allies lose one [Eureka].
